# COMBO_04 · Smoke Explosion Laced with Blue Shimmer

## 1. Search Summary (embedding target)

Smoke Explosion Laced with Blue Shimmer. A magic / energy explosion where glittering light particles scatter over a white smoke burst. Representative prompt: "Make a smoke explosion effect mixed with glittering light". White smoke (#F9EADA -> #555351) combined with blue light (#58BFFF, #81AEFF). Composition: Base SmokeBurst_A / Detail NeutralPulse_R_A, LightShimmer_A / Extra none. Duration 2s. Related vocabulary: shimmer, sparkle, glitter, light, glow, smoke, explosion, burst, magic, arcane, energy, blue, 반짝, 반짝임, 빛, 광채, 섬광, 연기, 스모크, 폭발, 터짐, 마법, 에너지, 신비, 푸른빛, 파랑, 스킬.

## 3. Composition Structure

| Layer | Source | Spawn | Size | Speed | Delay | Color (start -> end) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base | SmokeBurst_A | burst 2 | 1 | 5 | 0 | #F9EADA -> #555351 |
| Detail | NeutralPulse_R_A | rate 10/s x 0.5s | 1 | - | 0 | #58BFFF -> #071649 |
| Detail | LightShimmer_A | burst 13 | 1 | 0.8 | 0 | #81AEFF -> #353BD3 |

- Layer usage: Base 1 / Detail 2 / Extra 0 (3 sources total)
- Playback: `AutoActivate` True / `InfiniteLoop` False / `LoopCount` 1
- `LoopDuration` **2s** — read-only derived value. Cannot be set directly.
  - Determining factor: `SmokeBurst_A` (approx. 2.0s) is the maximum. `NeutralPulse_R_A` is shorter at 0.5s

## 4. Design Rationale (Why This Combination)

1. "Smoke explosion" sets the form, so `SmokeBurst_A` is the Base carrier. Speed 5 accelerates the spread to sell the detonation
2. "Glittering light" is decomposed into two Detail sources: `NeutralPulse_R_A` (rate 10/s) for a sustained afterglow and `LightShimmer_A` (burst 13) for instantaneous sparkle
3. The smoke stays achromatic and only the light is blue, creating contrast — tinting every layer the same color would instead look muddy

## 5. Applied Composition Patterns

- `smoke_carrier_base` — Smoke Base repurposed as a visual carrier
- `light_detail_stack` — Multiple stacked Light-family Details
- `pulse_plus_shimmer` — Pulse (sustained) + Shimmer (instantaneous)

## 7. Adaptation Guide (for the Agent)

- Recolor to #FFD84A tones for a holy / golden explosion, or #C060FF for a dark / arcane one
- Sparkle density: `LightShimmer_A` SpawnCount (13)
- To suppress the smoke and favor the light, raise `SmokeBurst_A` Transparency
